_source: DRAFT, not used by the app. Labels and aliases of the ancient places' Wikidata items (CC0) in 40 languages, fetched 2026-10-02 via OpenBible's links (linked_data). About 25 of OpenBible's links point to a modern city, a country, a people or a battle instead of the ancient place (Attalia -> Antalya, Rabbah -> Amman, Chaldea -> Chaldeans); see the session notes. Use for languages without a reviewed name only, after excluding those.
